workstreams.name: Prevent Merc Death in Town
workstreams.nextGate: Deploy the governed Release hash to BKVince, confirm a clean 92777 cold start with fresh logs, then validate lethal persistent-damage ticks in town and the out-of-scope controls.

workstreams.name: Vendor Stock Refresh
workstreams.nextGate: Prove one normal-vendor refresh before/after an item purchase while preserving the native gamble refresh; then extend the cold-started 0.1.0 prototype to controller, click-spam, global fallback and host/joiner tests.
